description: This Java source file contains integration tests for the Campaigns functionality in the Apache Fineract project. It tests campaign creation, update, activation, closure, reactivation, and deletion, covering different trigger types and error scenarios. The tests utilize REST-assured for HTTP requests, MockServer for mocking external dependencies, and JUnit 5 for testing framework.

classes.name: CampaignsTest
classes.description: Test class for campaign-related functionalities, including setup, mock server configuration, and multiple test cases for different campaign trigger types and error handling.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Prepares the REST-assured specification and helper object before each test.

methods.name: testSupportedActionsForCampaignWithTriggerTypeAsDirect
methods.description: Tests campaign lifecycle actions (create, update, activate, close, reactivate, delete) for campaigns with direct trigger type.

methods.name: testSupportedActionsForCampaignWithTriggerTypeAsScheduled
methods.description: Tests campaign lifecycle actions for campaigns with scheduled trigger type.

methods.name: testSupportedActionsForCampaignWithTriggerTypeAsTriggered
methods.description: Tests campaign lifecycle actions for campaigns with triggered trigger type.

methods.name: testSupportedActionsForCampaignWithError
methods.description: Tests the campaign actions, especially activation failures, error scenarios, and proper handling of error responses.
